plugin.name: Ollama
plugin.description: An Ollama connection for AI features: a local or remote Ollama server, model, context length and keep-alive time.
field.model.hint: A model you have pulled, e.g. llama3.1.
field.keepAlive.hint: How long the model stays in memory, e.g. 5m. Default 5m.
field.authHeader.hint: Only for an Ollama behind a proxy. Default Authorization.
field.secret.hint: Optional. The whole value, e.g. “Bearer …”. Written to the keychain only.
note.host: Only {host} can be reached through this connection (a local address is allowed because it is written here).
error.badUrl: The address must start with http:// or https://.
error.headerName: The auth header name is not valid.
error.pull: Model “{model}” is not downloaded. Run: ollama pull {model}
error.auth: The server did not accept the credentials
error.badAnswer: The answer could not be read.
test.noModels: Connected: Ollama {version}, but no model is downloaded. Run: ollama pull {model}
error.userInfo: The address must not contain a user name or password (user@host).
error.insecure: A remote address must use https://. Plain http:// is only allowed for this machine (127.0.0.1, localhost, [::1]).
